A robot program failed to move "red_pen" (kind: pen) onto "green_case".
Program:
```python
go_home()
obs = observe()
case = obs["zones"]["green_case"]
pen = obs["objects"]["red_pen"]

# Get grasp candidates and choose the one with fingers along the long axis
candidates = grasp_candidates("red_pen")
candidate = next(c for c in candidates if c["source"] == "geometry (fingers across the long side)")

# Grasp the pen at the correct height and orientation
grasp(candidate)

# Compute required yaw to align pen with green_case long axis
delta_yaw = case["long_axis_yaw"] - candidate["object_long_axis_yaw"]
rotate_by(delta_yaw)

# Carry to the center of green_case
carry_to(case["center"][0], case["center"][1], height=0.18)

# Lower until contact
lower_until_contact()

# Release
open_gripper()
retreat()

# Final check
check("red_pen", "green_case")
```

- The fingertip line (yaw) was 0 degrees from the object's long axis, so the fingers squeezed across a 0.137 m extent of the object (the open fingers are 0.08 m apart; footprint is 0.137 along long_axis_yaw x 0.012 along short_axis_yaw).
- After the program red_pen is offset [-0.1364, -0.1967] m from the centre of green_case ([-0.2297, 0.0672] m along / across the zone's long axis) (the zone half size along / across its long axis is [0.0765, 0.0223]); inside_zone=False, resting=True, gripper_holding=False.
- red_pen's long axis is 32.3 degrees from green_case's long axis; its top is 0.0119 m above the table (lying flat on the floor would be about 0.012 m).
Object as seen by the camera: {"height": 0.0119, "top_z": 0.8119, "footprint_long": 0.1368, "footprint_short": 0.0118, "long_axis_yaw": 0.695, "short_axis_yaw": -0.876}
